name: vdm-comms
description: Meetings and correspondence discipline: a configurable contract linter for meetings/<date>-<slug>/ and series files, with a project's own conventions switched on by name (comms.meeting-rules); a drift signal for the generated registry and per-track meeting pointers, written as markdown or Obsidian wikilinks; a draft guard that refuses to mark an unsent letter as sent, and an attachment checklist the sender can click; a communications skill (`letters`) on what an outgoing text — letter, message, SMS, ticket comment — carries and what stays out of it, with the reader's register (volunteer, executor, peer) declared per project and per letter, and who may write to a person read from `trust` in the HQ's people/ (the access layer names the HQ of a project that keeps none); and a pending-item detector that reads both date markers (clock and (due:)), series queues and unsent drafts, and answers who owes what by when. The wording of everything written into the project is configurable (comms.labels), defaulting to English.
